author: Richard Janisch

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_list_managers
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists all WinCC OA managers in the current project with their status (running/stopped). Use this when the user asks about managers, processes, or what's running in the WinCC OA system.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_datapoints
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches for datapoints in the WinCC OA system by pattern. Supports wildcards (*). Use this when the user asks about datapoints, data, values, or wants to find specific system elements. Examples: 'System1:*', '*Pump*', 'ExampleDP_Arg1.'

pattern.description: Datapoint search pattern with wildcards. Format: 'System:DpName*', 'DpName*', or '*substring*'. Examples: 'System1:*' (all in System1), '*Pump*' (all containing Pump), 'Tank_*' (all starting with Tank_), 'ExampleDP_Arg1.' (exact match). Use '*' to list all datapoints (warning: can be thousands!).

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_value
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the current value of a specific datapoint element in WinCC OA. Use this when the user asks for the current value, state, or status of a specific datapoint. The datapoint must be specified in the format 'System:DpName.Element' (e.g., 'System1:Pump.state').
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get current value of a datapoint element

dpe.description: Full datapoint element name to read. Format: 'System:DpName.Element.SubElement' or 'DpName.Element'. Examples: 'System1:Pump_01.state' (read pump state), 'Tank_Level.measurement' (read tank sensor), 'ExampleDP_Arg1.:_original.._value' (read internal value)

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_dptypes
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists datapoint type definitions in WinCC OA. Use this when the user asks about datapoint types, structures, or data models. Supports pattern matching with wildcards.

pattern.description: Type name search pattern with wildcards. Use '*' for all types, 'Pump*' for all pump types, '_*' for internal types. Examples: '*' (all), 'ExampleDP*' (all ExampleDP types), '_FwAlarmHdl*' (framework alarm types). Default: '*' (returns all types).

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_get_manager_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets detailed status information for a specific WinCC OA manager by name. Use this when the user asks about a specific manager's details, configuration, or state.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get detailed status of a specific manager

managerName.description: Name of the manager to query. Format: 'MANAGER_NUM' or exact manager identifier. Examples: 'DIST_1' (distribution manager), 'EVENT_1' (event manager), 'WCCOActrl_3' (CTRL manager #3), 'VALARCH' (value archive). Use winccoa_list_managers to see all available managers.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_create_datapoint
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new datapoint in the WinCC OA system. Use this when the user wants to add new datapoints to the system. Requires datapoint name and type.

dpeName.description: Name of the datapoint to create. Format: 'DpName' without system prefix. Examples: 'Pump_01', 'Tank_Level', 'Sensor_Temperature_Hall1', '_mp_MyDPT' (master datapoint). Use descriptive names following project naming conventions. Master datapoints start with '_mp_'.

dpType.description: Datapoint type name (must exist in WinCC OA). Common built-in types: 'ExampleDP_Float', 'ExampleDP_Int', 'ExampleDP_Bool', 'ExampleDP_Bit32', 'ExampleDP_Char', 'ExampleDP_String', 'ExampleDP_Time', 'ExampleDP_Dpid'. Use 'winccoa_get_dptypes' to list available types in the project.

systemId.description: System ID for distributed WinCC OA systems (optional). Default: 1 (local system). Valid range: 1-255. Only needed in multi-system configurations.

dpId.description: Specific datapoint ID to assign (optional, WinCC OA auto-generates if not provided). Valid range: 1-2147483647. WARNING: Duplicate IDs will cause errors!

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_dp_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sets the value of a datapoint element in WinCC OA. **WARNING:** This directly controls industrial equipment. Use with extreme caution! Requires user confirmation before execution.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Write value to a datapoint (CAUTION: controls real equipment!)

dpeName.description: Full datapoint element name with system prefix and element path. Format: 'System:DpName.Element.SubElement' or 'DpName.Element'. Examples: 'System1:Pump_01.cmd.start', 'Tank_Level.value', 'Sensor_Temperature_Hall1.measurement'

value.description: Value to write - type must match datapoint element type. Numbers for numeric types, strings for text, boolean for bool, array for dyn types. Examples: 123.45 (float), true (bool), 'Running' (string), [1,2,3] (dyn_int)

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_create_dp_type
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new datapoint type (DPT) with structure definition in WinCC OA. Use this when the user wants to define new data structures/templates for datapoints.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a new datapoint type structure

structure.description: Structure definition (JSON tree with name, type, children)

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_alarm_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Configures alarm thresholds and settings for a datapoint element. Supports binary alarms (BOOL) and analog alarms (numeric types with 1-3 thresholds). Use when the user wants to set up alarm monitoring.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Configure alarm thresholds for a datapoint

dpe.description: Datapoint element to configure alarm on. Format: 'System:DpName.Element' or 'DpName.Element'. Examples: 'System1:Tank_Level.measurement', 'Pump_Temperature.value'

direction.description: Alarm direction: ASC (ascending, higher values trigger higher severity) or DESC (descending, lower values trigger higher severity). Example: ASC for high temperature alarm, DESC for low level alarm. Default classes: ASC=['information.','warning.','alert.'], DESC=['alert.','warning.','information.'].

thresholds.description: Threshold values for analog alarms (1-3 values). Order: [warning, alarm, severe] for ASC or [low_severe, low_alarm, low_warning] for DESC. Examples: [80.0, 90.0, 95.0] for tank level warnings at 80%/90%/95%.

alarmClasses.description: WinCC OA alarm class names corresponding to each threshold (must match threshold count). Common values: '_warning', '_alert', '_error'. Defaults to standard classes if omitted.

force.description: Force update if alarm config already exists. false = skip if exists, true = overwrite existing config.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_alarm_delete
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes alarm configuration from a datapoint element. Use when the user wants to remove alarm monitoring. This action cannot be undone!
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delete alarm configuration from a datapoint

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_archive_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Configures archiving (historical data collection) for a datapoint element. Use when the user wants to enable historical data logging for trend analysis.

dpe.description: Datapoint element to enable archiving on. Format: 'System:DpName.Element' or 'DpName.Element'. Examples: 'System1:Tank_Level.measurement', 'Pump_Speed.value', 'Temperature_Sensor_Hall1.reading'

archiveClass.description: WinCC OA archive class name (predefined in project). Common values: '_NGA_G_EVENT' (value change), '_NGA_G_1S' (1 second), '_NGA_G_1M' (1 minute), '_NGA_G_1H' (1 hour). Default is event-driven archiving.

force.description: Force update if archive config already exists. false = skip if exists, true = overwrite existing config.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_common_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sets common configuration attributes for a datapoint element (description, alias, format, unit). Use when the user wants to add metadata or display properties to datapoints.

dpe.description: Datapoint element to configure. Format: 'System:DpName.Element' or 'DpName.Element'. Examples: 'System1:Tank_Level.measurement', 'Pump_01.cmd.start'

description.description: Human-readable description for operators/documentation. Examples: 'Main tank level sensor in Hall 3', 'Pump emergency stop command'. Supports multi-language via WinCC OA lang mapping if needed.

alias.description: Short alias/tag name for display in SCADA panels. Examples: 'TK_LVL_H3', 'P01_ESTOP'. Typically uppercase with underscores.

format.description: Display format string for numeric values. Examples: '%.2f' (2 decimals), '%d' (integer), '%.1f °C' (1 decimal with unit). Use standard printf formatting.

unit.description: Engineering unit for measurement values. Examples: 'm' (meters), '°C', 'bar', 'kW', 'rpm', '%'. Displayed in trends and SCADA panels.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_pv_range_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sets min/max value range validation for a datapoint element. Use when the user wants to define valid value boundaries for inputs/outputs.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Set min/max value range for a datapoint

dpe.description: Datapoint element to set range limits on. Format: 'System:DpName.Element' or 'DpName.Element'. Examples: 'System1:Valve_Position.setpoint', 'Temperature_Sensor.value'

min.description: Minimum allowed value. WinCC OA rejects writes below this value. Examples: 0.0 for percentage, -40.0 for temperature in °C, 0 for unsigned counters.

max.description: Maximum allowed value. WinCC OA rejects writes above this value. Examples: 100.0 for percentage, 150.0 for temperature in °C, 65535 for 16-bit counter.

includeMin.description: Include minimum value in valid range. true = value >= min allowed, false = value > min required (excludes exact min). Default: true.

includeMax.description: Include maximum value in valid range. true = value <= max allowed, false = value < max required (excludes exact max). Default: true.

force.description: Force update if PV range config already exists. false = skip if exists, true = overwrite existing config.

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_modbus_address_get
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the current Modbus address configuration from a datapoint element. Returns reference, datatype, direction, connection and device IDs. Use to query existing peripheral address settings before modifying.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get Modbus address configuration from a datapoint

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_modbus_address_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Configures Modbus address settings for a datapoint element. Sets up both peripheral address (_address) and distribution (_distrib) configurations. The reference format is M.<ConnectionId>.<FunctionCode>.<RegisterAddress> where FunctionCode determines the Modbus operation (1=ReadCoils, 2=ReadDiscreteInputs, 3=ReadHoldingRegisters, 4=ReadInputRegisters, 5=WriteCoil, 6=WriteSingleRegister, 15=WriteMultipleCoils, 16=WriteMultipleRegisters).
languageModelTools.userDescription: Configure Modbus address for a datapoint

dpName.description: Full datapoint element name including system prefix (format: 'System:DpName.Element' or 'DpName.Element'). Example: 'ModbusDevice_1.measurements.temperature'

connectionId.description: Modbus connection ID as configured in WinCC OA Modbus driver (valid range: 0-255)

functionCode.description: Modbus function code determining the operation type: 1=FC01 Read Coils, 2=FC02 Read Discrete Inputs, 3=FC03 Read Holding Registers, 4=FC04 Read Input Registers, 5=FC05 Write Single Coil, 6=FC06 Write Single Register, 15=FC15 Write Multiple Coils, 16=FC16 Write Multiple Registers

registerAddress.description: Modbus register address to read/write (valid range: 0-65535). Use Modbus documentation to find correct address.

datatype.description: Modbus datatype transformation. Verified values: 566=FLOAT (32-bit), 567=BIT (for coils/discrete inputs). Default: 566 (FLOAT).

direction.description: Address direction mode (0-15). Common values: 0=UNDEFINED, 1=OUTPUT, 2=INPUT_SPONT, 4=INPUT_POLL(cyclic read), 6=IO_SPONT, 7=IO_POLL(bidirectional), 11=INPUT_CYCLIC_ON_USE. Default: 4 (INPUT_POLL).

active.description: Activate address immediately after configuration (default: true)

lowlevel.description: Enable low-level value comparison to reduce network traffic (default: true)

languageModelTools.name: winccoa_modbus_address_remove
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Removes Modbus address configuration from a datapoint element. Deactivates the address and clears distribution config.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Remove Modbus address from a datapoint
